prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Next: Quick Controls", "Master Your Desktop Companion", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or open settings. Drag to reposition anywhere on screen.", "Start Playing", "Right Click = Controls Menu", "Drag & Drop = Move Pet"]
1: ["Choose Your Perfect Companion", "Select a personality template to customize your pet's desktop behaviors.", "Companion Personas"]
2: ["What Kind of Companion Do You Need?", "Tell us how you spend time on your desktop to get a personalized recommendation.", "See Recommendation", "Primary Activity"]
3: []
4: ["Protect Your Pet with Cloud Sync", "Signing in links your customized companion to your account so progress and custom items are never lost.", "Already have an account? Sign in to restore your existing companions."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Arrival", "Your companion will appear in your system tray when rendering completes.", "Check your system tray area near the taskbar clock if the window closes."]
6: ["Official Companion Adoption Certificate", "Your pet's personality profile and name are registered to your account.", "Your adoption record is backed up automatically to prevent pet loss."]
7: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience", "Complete onboarding to receive exclusive starter items for your new virtual companion.", "Includes exclusive desktop pet accessories upon completion.", "Starter Pack Unlocked"]
8: ["Custom Pet Creation Studio", "Upload a clear, well-lit image of your pet or favorite character for best AI generation results.", "Avoid blurry images or dark backgrounds to ensure accurate rendering."]
9: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "Click below to summon your pet to your desktop screen now.", "Summon Desktop Pet"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information about the user's desktop habits and activities.
Promotes free extras and exclusive gifts for completing onboarding.
